notes.title: 1.37 Balance Changes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/1d31d1f7ad36808ff36e520e75fe7aa21269cb91.png[/img]

[i]The Fall of Argenport[/i] has completely flipped both the ranked and draft formats on their heads. Overall, we've been very happy with the great diversity of cards and strategies getting played, as well as how new of a world FoA has lead to. 

Although the metagame has been evolving a great deal from week to week, we have identified two specific areas we wanted to give a little nudge to, in order to better ensure a greater range of competitive strategies remain viable.

While many variations of aggressive "Spells Matter" decks have enjoyed success in the new format, there has been a growing trend towards TJP builds (ie Blitz, ie Miracle) that have been able to incorporate heavy Flying and Aegis themes, without sacrificing very much speed. While some strategies have been able to evolve to meet this new kind of threat, it has been pushing out a few entire classes of strategies, by being just a little too efficient at sidestepping interaction (spells, weapons, and units, thanks to Aegis, pump spells, and Flying). By contrast, the Time Midrange strategies that initially rose to prominence lead to an evolution of the format that continued to allow most strategies to be competitive, when properly tuned.

We discussed a lot of options, when considering what actions to take. Many of the units in the TJP decks are quite strong, but they actually offer a great range of gameplay, a lot of compelling deckbuilding decisions, and a great depth of strategy for maximizing use of them. We will be continuing to monitor them, but on the whole, we currently see no problem with the actual units available.

We also discussed the pump spells, especially Gift of Battle, which has generally been the most common theme when the deck has explosive turns attacking for huge amounts out of nowhere. What we eventually concluded was that the real problem was how frequently these big turns were so difficult to interact with, with two cards standing out as the biggest offenders of making it too easy to dodge unit combat.
[list][*][b]Accelerated Evolution[/b] - Now 3TP (was 2TP)
[*][b]Levitate[/b] - Now 2P (was 1P)[/list]
Accelerated Evolution has been a reasonable roleplayer since its inception, but has skyrocketed in power, thanks to it's synergy with the Spells Matter cards (counting as two spells, while also being able to enhance two threats) and its synergy with Merchants (giving you extra material to trade in or receive). Additionally, it has proven just a little too effective at reducing the amount of investment needed to go for a big turn (since its inherently spread out).

Levitate has always been an extremely efficient spell with low opportunity cost, thanks to it replacing itself, and has been watched closely for a very long time. While the card has arguably been too strong for a long time, it was never really particularly heavily played until recently (where it has been one of the biggest offenders of a reduction of diversity of types of spells used to fuel spells matter cards). Our intention is not to eliminate these strategies ability to take to the skies, we just want to make sure there is sufficient opportunity cost for it to be a meaningful investment.

[h1]Other changes:[/h1][list]
[*][b]Sheriff's Hat[/b] - Now +3/+1 (was +3/+3)
[*][b]Herald of the Parliament[/b] - Now 1/1 that gets +2/+2 (was a 2/2 that gets +1/+1)
[*][b]Brand, Without Fear[/b] (created by Jawbone Greatsword) - Now 6FF (was 7FF)
[*][b]Ijin's Choice[/b] - Now fast (was slow)
[*][b]Shadowstalker[/b] - Now 3SS (was 4SS)[/list]

[b]Sheriff's Hat, Herald of the Parliament[/b] - While the draft format has been relatively well balanced, Justice has been just a little stronger than we'd like. Both of these changes emphasize the unit's ability, making "completing the quest" a more meaningful part of the card's power.

While [b]Jawbone Greatsword[/b] has already proven an effective card, we wanted to put a little more juice into its Tribute ability, to give more reward to players completing its quest. 

[b]Shadowstalker[/b] - We wanted to give a boost to Nightfall decks, while potentially also opening up chances of another ranked option for a few fringe decks.

[b]Ijin's Choice[/b] - This is largely a quality of life improvement, making the card less stressful to use, while better balancing the two modes with each other. Additionally, this may get the card into more ranked decks, thanks to the added flexibility.

We're continuing to monitor ranked, but wanted to err on the side of being conservative with changes, as we're confident there is a lot more hidden in the format and would prefer to see where things go.

notes.content:

[h1]New Set: The Fall of Argenport[/h1]
[list][*]Over 275 new cards and new mechanics have been added to [i]Eternal[/i].
[*]The new set is now available for purchase from the store and can be crafted via Shiftstone.
[*]New Theme decks are now available for purchase from the store.
[*]The Draft format has changed to draft the new set along with new curated Draft Packs from previous sets, outlined [url=https://www.direwolfdigital.com/news/draft-packs/]HERE.[/url][/list]

[h1]Gauntlet/Forge Season End[/h1]
[list][*]Progress for all players has been reset in both Gauntlet and Forge.
[*]New AI opponents have been added, including new bosses in the Gauntlet.
[*]Some existing AI decks have been updated to include cards from the new set.[/list]

[h1]Reward Update[/h1]
[list][*]Packs from season rewards, rank up chests in the Gauntlet and Forge, and the free pack awarded for first win of the day have all been updated to give packs from The Fall of Argenport.
[*]Packs from standard chests have been updated to randomize between The Eternal Throne, Omens of the Past, and The Dusk Road, weighted according to the number of cards in each set.
[*]New Achievements added.[/list]

[h1]New Totems[/h1]
[list][*]Five new Totems are available to purchase in the store, themed to each of the five factions.[/list]

[h1]UI Updates[/h1]
[list][*]The deck builder will have a separate tab for creating a Market.
[*]A Market icon will appear on the playmat if you are playing with a Market.
[*]Card zoom in is now available on smartphone during draft mode to see amount owned.[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[b]General[/b]
[list][*]Importing a deck will now prioritize adding premium versions of owned cards.[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Destiny units drawn from the void should now correctly draw you a card from your deck.
[*]Units with both Ambush and Bond should be able to be played with Bond when Ambush cards can usually be played. 
[*]When a card with Warp is put back on top of the deck with Second Sight, it should now correctly display face-up.
[*]Cards played by Destiny that require a target should now correctly present when drawn.[/list]

[b]Card Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Disassembler’s ability should now correctly deal damage when the opponent has a Statuary Maiden in play.
[*]Rakano Sheriff’s ability can no longer be used while Hooru Pacifier is in play.
[*]Strategize should now interact correctly when drawing cards with Destiny.
[*]Drawing a Lumen Shepherd off of a Timeworn Sentinel’s Ally ability will no longer cause the board to fill with Wisps.
[*]The created card from Veteran Mercenary is no longer displayed to the enemy player.
[*]Last Word no longer gives Deadly to Devastating Setback.
[*]Steelfang Chakram should now interact correctly with transformed units.[/list]

notes.title: 1.31.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/55049e6c976d02f2742d043ab6643fec1c2f4a85.png[/img]

[h1]Event UI Updates[/h1]
[list][*]Events are now presented in a selection array, making it easier to identify when there are multiple Events.
[*]Decks can now be imported/exported from the expanded deck view. This also works for draft decks!
[*]Leagues now support viewing sample hands.
[*]The New tag should now work when browsing your League pool, making it easier to identify cards from new packs.[/list]

[h1]Card Updates[/h1]
There is an ebb and flow to healthy metagames, and while we're keeping an eye on the prevalence of unitless control decks, overall, we've been pretty happy with the post Dead Reckoning meta. Now that things have settled down a bit, we wanted to give a boost to a couple cards with some interesting potential against slower Primal decks, and a couple compelling new options for Primal decks seeking to be a little more proactive.
[list][*][b]Snapping Brushstalker[/b] - Now a 5/5 (was a 5/4)
[*][b]Crownwatch Press-Gang[/b] - Now costs 4J (was 5J)
[*][b]Jotun Feast-Caller[/b] - Now 4/4 (was 4/3)
[*][b]Kaleb Reborn[/b] - Now Ultimate: Pay 5 (was Ultimate: Pay 6)[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]The Next Pack timer in Leagues should now correctly display on PCs with a 1680x1050 resolution.
[*]The claim button that appears when an event ends should now be back.
[*]The profile VFX for the premium Brenn, Chronicler of Ages avatar should now look correct on Android devices.

notes.title: 1.31 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/6c4df487cc148a6137a1574c66140d0f5e3799d6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Heroes and Chapters Update[/h1]
[list][*]Seasons in the game will now be labelled as “Chapters”.
[*]All named characters will get a searchable “Hero” tag to help identify their special status in the world. At
present, this is an under-the- hood change with no mechanical effects.[/list]

[h1]Twitch Streaming Integration[/h1]
[list][*]Decklists will now auto-scale to display better at small window sizes.
[*]The extension will now notify viewers if they can’t use it because the streamer has it disabled.
[*]There have been multiple bug fixes and quality of life improvements.[/list]

[h1]Premium Avatar: Snowman[/h1]
[list][*]The time-limited Premium Avatar: Snowman has been removed from the store.[/list]

[h1]UI Updates[/h1]
[list][*]Muting an enemy avatar on mobile now requires a long press and hold.
[*]You can now disable screen shake from the options menu.[/list]

[h1]Min Supported Client Update[/h1]
[list][*]Min client for OSX has been updated from 10.8 to 10.9
[*]Min client for iOS has been updated to 10.0[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[b]Client Fixes[/b]
[b]General[/b]
[list][*]Advanced Filters should now displays the correct pack art for each set.
[*]Importing a deck from the clipboard should now work on mobile again.
[*]Card text should no longer convert to code if they are referencing another card name with a comma in its name.
[*]Emotes should now block being able to click through them to the units underneath.[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Units that transform into Cloudsnake Harrier should no longer retain modifications from the
previous unit.[/list]

[b]Card Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Novaquake Titan should no longer create black squares as part of its bond VFX.
[*]Champion of Vengeance should now get the +2 strength when using a killer attack.
[*]Hooru Pacifier should no longer display a visual glow while it is the top-most card in your void.
[*]Units that have a negative strength value but should be able to attack due to Accelerated Impact should now
be able to do so.
[*]Dizo, Cabal Chairman should now work with deck import/export.[/list]

notes.title: Seeds of Unrest Draft Event
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/668f79e4b799a6620f5a6875e4e82de801341893.png[/img]
Join us this weekend for [i]Eternal[/i]'s first draft event!

The Rebellion suffered a devastating loss at the Battle of Argenport, but the seeds of hope remain. Far from the capital, others take up the cause with a vow that they will never surrender.

The Seeds of Unrest event uses a special draft format:
[list][*][i]The Dusk Road[/i]
[*]Eternal Draft Pack
[*]Eternal Draft Pack
[*][i]The Dusk Road[/i][/list]
Eternal Draft Packs contain a specially curated pool of cards selected from [i]The Empty Throne[/i] and [i]Omens of the Past[/i]. You'll draft them just like a normal pack (and keep what you draft), but the cards in the pool are specifically chosen to be drafted in this event.
[list][*]The Seeds of Unrest event costs 7,500 gold or 600 gems to enter.
[*]Each run consists of 10 games, win or lose.
[*]Your first three runs will determine your position on the event leaderboard.
[*]Rewards for this event are determined by final leaderboard position.
[*]First place receives 30 packs of [i]The Dusk Road[/i], 10 Draft Tickets, and 4 premium copies of Strategize.
[*]All players will receive a minimum of 3 packs of [i]The Dusk Road[/i] and a premium Strategize (plus the cards you drafted).[/list]

The Seeds of Unrest event kicks off on Friday and runs all weekend. What are you going to open?

We’ll see you in the game!

notes.title: Patch 1.29 - Dead Reckoning
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/404c9b58fac4f736b641b5e5acf96a1c72a5147c.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Campaign: Dead Reckoning[/h1]
[list][*]Play as Icaria in the latest campaign to hit Eternal!
[*]The Dead Reckoning campaign is now available for 1,000 gems or 25,000 gold.
[*]Play 18 new missions and collect all 25 new cards.[/list]

[h1]New Premium Avatar: Icaria, Valkyrie Captain[/h1]
[list][*]The Icaria, Valkyrie Captain premium avatar is now available for 300 gems.
[*]Includes premium animations and custom valkyrie wings on the playmat.
[*]Comes with a custom emote: "Face your judgment!"[/list]

[h1]Twitch Streaming Integration[/h1]
Players who stream Eternal can now link their twitch accounts. Paired with the Eternal Stream Extension, you can provide viewers the ability to:
[list][*]Zoom cards on your playmat
[*]View your deck list (including optional export functionality)
[*]View your deck list while you Draft, Forge, or build decks in the Deck Builder.[/list]

[h1]Voidbound[/h1]
[list][*]“Voidbound” has been added to cards that can’t leave the void to increase clarity and remove text clutter.
[*]There is no functional change from the text-based description.[/list]

[h1]UI Updates[/h1]
[list][*]Create All will now only craft unowned cards if all unowned cards can be crafted.
[*]The message of the day will now highlight new tiles to make it easier to find news you haven’t read yet.
[*]Cards that display a list of selections should now stack all identical cards and show how many cards are in each stack.[/list]

[h1]Min Supported Update Coming[/h1]
We will be updating the required min client for both OSX and iOS in the next major release, 1.30
[list][*]OSX will be updating from 10.8 to 10.9
[*]iOS will be updating to 10.0[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[b]Client Fixes[/b]
[b]General[/b]
[list][*]The Shifting Alliances Gauntlet boss should now correctly apply the +1/+1 to transformed units that transformed into multi-faction units.[/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Attempting to create units while you have a full board should now fail. This should fix the issue with Champion of Order creating too many copies of himself.
[*]End of turn timing has been updated to allow you to play cards like Sleeping Draught at the end of your own turn.[/list]
[b]Card Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Scepter of Nobility should no longer have its cost reduced if your only unit wielding a weapon was stolen.
[*]Kaleb, Uncrowned Prince should no longer play weapons with restrictions on invalid targets.
[*]Valkyrie Bodyguard should no longer be able to use a killer attack if the player doesn’t have armor.
[*]Units stunned by Winter’s Grasp should no longer lose stun if they were wielding a weapon and were transformed.
[*]Previously, several spells would fail to resolve each of their abilities if their target was removed in response. The following list of spells have been fixed:
[*]Shield Bash - You will now draw a card.
[*]Decay - You will now gain the 3 health.
[*]Dispel - You will now draw a card.
[*]Ironclad Oath - You will now gain 1 armor for each of your valkyrie.
[*]Jotun Birth Song - You will now search your deck for Yeti.
[*]Execute - Will still deal 2 damage.
[*]Cover of Darkness - Nightfall will still occur.
[*]Excavate - You will now gain the 2 health.
[*]Cruciation has received a template change to indicate that it must kill the unit in order to gain the health. No gameplay change.
[*]Cudgels created by Statuary Maiden should now always go to your hand, even if you have a Shadowlands Feaster in play.
[*]Levitate should now require a target in order to be played.
[*]Returning a relic weapon to hand with Dig Site should no longer leave the armor behind on the player.[/list]

[h1]New Campaign: Dead Reckoning[/h1]
[list][*]Play as Icaria in the latest campaign to hit Eternal!
[*]The Dead Reckoning campaign is now available for 1,000 gems or 25,000 gold.
[*]Play 18 new missions and collect all 25 new cards.[/list]

[h1]New Premium Avatar: Icaria, Valkyrie Captain[/h1]
[list][*]The Icaria, Valkyrie Captain premium avatar is now available for 300 gems.
[*]Includes premium animations and custom valkyrie wings on the playmat.
[*]Comes with a custom emote: "Face your judgment!"[/list]

[h1]Twitch Streaming Integration[/h1]
Players who stream Eternal can now link their twitch accounts. Paired with the Eternal Stream Extension, you can provide viewers the ability to:
[list][*]Zoom cards on your playmat
[*]View your deck list (including optional export functionality)
[*]View your deck list while you Draft, Forge, or build decks in the Deck Builder.[/list]

[h1]Voidbound[/h1]
[list][*]“Voidbound” has been added to cards that can’t leave the void to increase clarity and remove text clutter.
[*]There is no functional change from the text-based description.[/list]

[h1]UI Updates[/h1]
[list][*]Create All will now only craft unowned cards if all unowned cards can be crafted.
[*]The message of the day will now highlight new tiles to make it easier to find news you haven’t read yet.
[*]Cards that display a list of selections should now stack all identical cards and show how many cards are in each stack.[/list]

[h1]Min Supported Update Coming[/h1]
We will be updating the required min client for both OSX and iOS in the next major release, 1.30
[list][*]OSX will be updating from 10.8 to 10.9
[*]iOS will be updating to 10.0[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[b]Client Fixes[/b]
[b]General[/b]
[list][*]The Shifting Alliances Gauntlet boss should now correctly apply the +1/+1 to transformed units that transformed into multi-faction units.[/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Attempting to create units while you have a full board should now fail. This should fix the issue with Champion of Order creating too many copies of himself.
[*]End of turn timing has been updated to allow you to play cards like Sleeping Draught at the end of your own turn.[/list]
[b]Card Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Scepter of Nobility should no longer have its cost reduced if your only unit wielding a weapon was stolen.
[*]Kaleb, Uncrowned Prince should no longer play weapons with restrictions on invalid targets.
[*]Valkyrie Bodyguard should no longer be able to use a killer attack if the player doesn’t have armor.
[*]Units stunned by Winter’s Grasp should no longer lose stun if they were wielding a weapon and were transformed.
[*]Previously, several spells would fail to resolve each of their abilities if their target was removed in response. The following list of spells have been fixed:
[*]Shield Bash - You will now draw a card.
[*]Decay - You will now gain the 3 health.
[*]Dispel - You will now draw a card.
[*]Ironclad Oath - You will now gain 1 armor for each of your valkyrie.
[*]Jotun Birth Song - You will now search your deck for Yeti.
[*]Execute - Will still deal 2 damage.
[*]Cover of Darkness - Nightfall will still occur.
[*]Excavate - You will now gain the 2 health.
[*]Cruciation has received a template change to indicate that it must kill the unit in order to gain the health. No gameplay change.
[*]Cudgels created by Statuary Maiden should now always go to your hand, even if you have a Shadowlands Feaster in play.
[*]Levitate should now require a target in order to be played.
[*]Returning a relic weapon to hand with Dig Site should no longer leave the armor behind on the player.[/list]

notes.title: 1.28.7 Balance Changes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/55293879a07ccb97c5a14d7502f353f0c2e06b40.png[/img]
We'll be patching out some additional balance changes in the next day or two, and it'll be another big one, with a lot of nerfs, and even more buffs. Normally, we’d prefer not to make a second large wave of changes so soon after a major balance patch, but we were a little too conservative in a couple of spots, and a little too aggressive in a couple of others. 

When we changed Statuary Maiden and Steward of the Past to be compatible with the rest of the game’s rule set, we knew that we’d need to make some follow-up adjustments, too. A lot of the game’s balance involved those two cards in ways that would need to change with their updates, and we had some of those changes ready, such as Dawnwalker’s.

Nevertheless, you guys quickly developed powerful ways to exploit the changes in void-interaction. While you also found extreme ways to fight back against these strategies, it quickly shifted the focus of the format away from some of the more fun aspects of the game’s experience, and ended up limiting some of the range of meaningful interaction. To address this, we’re pulling forward some important changes aimed at a bit more short-term upheaval to the metagame.

One additional note - when we were preparing for the last round of balance changes, there was a lot of community speculation and discussion about Tavrod, Auric Broker. Big victory conditions can often hog the credit, since they so frequently get to deal the killing blow. However, Tavrod doesn't appear to be out of line compared to other strong finishers. There was more of an issue with the efficiency of a couple nuts and bolts cards, contributing to Justice decks of all sorts being a little too resilient. We'll continue to keep an eye on him as the metagame evolves, but no changes to Tavrod are necessary, at the moment.

[b]Nerfs:[/b]
[list][*][b]Elysian Pathfinder[/b] - Now 7TTT (was 5TT) 
[*][b]Elysian Trailblazer[/b] - Now 7PPP (was 5PP)[/list]
Giving echo to cards that aren’t supposed to have it can be fun, but it can also lead to incredibly repetitive game-states [i](Makto, Piercing Grief, Second Sight, Excavate, we’re looking at you…)[/i]. While it has proven challenging to balance, one of the biggest problems has been the lack of sufficient counterplay. We believe there’s potential here; however, we’ve decided to pull way back on the power level until a sufficient quantity and quality of counterplay can arise.

We knew there were problems with these two, but it was ultimately a (hotly debated, fwiw) mistake on our part to not take larger action in the last patch.  

[list][*][b]Vara, Fate-Touched[/b] - Now "When you play another Shadow unit, play an additional Shadow unit from your void." (was "When you play Vara or another Shadow unit...)[/list]
Vara has always caused a number of rules problems behind the scenes with the “not-quite-summon” aspect of her ability. Additionally, her ability to chain so effortlessly with other copies of herself can greatly restrict the range of reasonable endgame strategies. The recent change to Steward of the Past was the tipping point, and while Vara-based strategies could definitely be beaten, she’s been cutting off the majority of non-Fast Aggro strategies. 

This change preserves her primary play pattern and high power ceiling, but now requires more investment and risk, with a lower floor.

[list][*][b]Soulfire Drake[/b] - Now 6FFF (was 5FFF)[/list]
Soulfire Drake has long been a ranked powerhouse, and while it can provide for some very exciting games, the change to Steward of the Past has led to it running away with the five-spot in the majority of Rakano, Stonescar, Skycrag (and even some Praxis) aggro decks. It was also one of the bigger contributors to the meta being a little more about Charge than we’d like.

[list][*][b]Protect[/b] - Now 2J (was 1J)[/list]
Protect is a classic – versatile and brutal in its efficiency. Unfortunately, costing only a single power and being able to do everything makes it difficult to then design other variations of this effect. In recent months, the tempo swings from Protect have been a major contributor to everything from fast Rakano decks winning on turn five through removal, to enabling cards like Makto, Tavrod, and Statuary Maiden. Powerful cards that can dominate the field of battle are an important part of the game, but when it’s too easy to protect them (i.e., not enough risk), the significance of many in-game decisions is reduced.

[list][*][b]Wanted Poster[/b] - Now 2J (was 1J)[/list]
The change to Dawnwalker reduced its effectiveness as a countermeasure against “all-removal” decks. While the format was able to adjust, there was a little too much incentive to avoid playing units or to win as fast as possible. The best gameplay from Wanted Poster comes from taking the risk of putting one on a unit, then trying to kill it on your next turn to earn your reward. At one-cost, it was just getting played in the same turn as the removal spell a significant amount of the time. Getting card draw above rate for completing a quest can be great, but the cost has to be more appropriate for the difficulty of the quest.

[list][*][b]Stonepowder Alchemist[/b] - Now 2/1 (was 2/2)[/list]
We knew reducing Stonepowder Alchemist’s cost to 3 was a substantial buff, but it did come in a little higher than we’d have liked. We wanted to preserve as much of its strength at countering aggressive fire strategies as we could, while introducing a few more weaknesses into the card, when facing midrange or control strategies. 

[list][*][b]Entrapment[/b] - Now 4J (Was 3J)
[*][b]Spiritblade Stalker[/b] - Now 6-cost ultimate (was 5-cost)
[*][b]Roosting Owl[/b] - Now 2/3 (was 2/4)[/list]
While we made a few changes to Justice in draft last time around, we didn’t go far enough. In an effort to diversify the types of strategies that can work well in draft, we’ve pulled back slightly on the efficiency of some of its commons. Improving draft balance doesn’t necessarily mean nerfing a faction’s best commons. It’s ok for cards to be good, and it’s ok to weaken a faction by pulling back on a card in the middle of the pack, or even lower down.

[list][*][b]Lastlight Druid[/b] - Now 4P 1/4 "Summon: Nightfall. When you end a turn at Night, transform each other unit you played this turn into a random unit with cost 1 greater." (was 3P 1/5 "Summon: Nightfall, Other units you play at Night transform into random units with cost 1 greater.")[/list]
While not intended as a nerf or a buff, Lastlight Druid needed to be reworked because of some rules problems stemming from its unusual timing.

[b]Buffs:[/b]
[list][*][b]Into the Furnace[/b] - Now fast (was slow)
[*][b]Topple Tower[/b] - Now 0/5 (was 0/4)
[*][b]Amaran Shoveler[/b] - Now 1 to use (was 2 to use)
[*][b]Lunar Magus[/b] - Now 3/4 (was 2/4)
[*][b]Reliquary Raider[/b] - Now 3TT 1/3 You gain 3 health when she blocks (was 5T 4/4 You gain 4 health when she blocks)
[*][b]Seasoned Spelunker[/b] - Now +2/+2 while you have a relic (was +1/+1)
[*][b]Stirring Sand[/b] - Now 4TT but plays the Sentinel exhausted (was 5TT and ready).
[*][b]Parapet Sentry[/b] - Now has +2/+2 while you have a relic (was +1/+1)
[*][b]Bellowing Thunderfoot[/b] - Now 5/5 (was 4/5)
[*][b]Thudrock, Artic Artisan[/b] - Now 5/4 (was 5/3)
[*][b]Amethyst Monument[/b] - Now makes a 4/4 Puma (was a 3/3)
[*][b]Cabal Slasher[/b] - Now 2S (was 3S)
[*][b]Iceberg Warchief[/b] - Now 5/3 that gives your Yeti +2/+0 and your spells +2 damage (instead of 5/4 that gives +1/+0 and +1 spell damage).
[*][b]Ayan, the Abductor[/b] - Now 8-cost ultimate (was 9-cost)
[*][b]Mask of Torment[/b] - Now 4TS (was 5TS)[/list]

One of the most fun parts of Eternal is exploring unknown formats and discovering what might be possible with the introduction of new cards or strategies. While we’re not looking for perpetual table-flipping, we have been a little more conservative in recent months than we’ve planned to be.

As always, we genuinely appreciate the full range of feedback you all send us, from the positive about what’s working particularly well, to the constructive about what might be an opportunity to improve. We won’t always hit the mark dead-on, but we are always going to read and absorb every piece of feedback we receive in our quest to make this game better and better. Thanks again for your support, and for being a part of such an awesome community!

notes.title: Patch 1.28 - Draft & Card Changes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/0c902e384938196177460fcaffd9b9d14d53dc0d.png[/img]

[b]Update to the Dusk Road Draft Format[/b]
[list]To provide increased control over The Dusk Road draft experience, both Dusk Road packs passed in a draft will come from the same player (player A), and the Omens of the Past and The Empty Throne packs will come from the same other player (player B).  We have also introduced a new collation system that will be used with Dusk Road packs (and other packs going forward) to help increase diversity among commons. These changes allow for better use of the signals from the first pack of The Dusk Road, in predicting what might show up in the second pack of The Dusk Road.[/list]
[list]Players will now also have more control over the player passing to them for Omens of the Past and The Empty Throne.[/list]

[b]Card Changes Aimed at Draft[/b]
[list]Valkyrie Arcanist - Now 6JJ (instead of 5JJ)[/list]
[list]Emerald Spear - Now 7J +4/+3 (instead of 6J +3/+3)[/list]
[list]Frontier Confessor - Now 4J 3/2 (instead of 5J 3/4)[/list]

Justice-based draft decks, particularly those that tie up the ground and win in the air, were a little too dominant. These changes aim to slightly reduce how easy this is and hopefully open up diversity of draft strategies.

[b]Cleaning Up Rules Around Void Interaction[/b]
[list]Statuary Maiden - Now reads: Enemy units can't Entomb or Revenge. When an enemy unit dies, transform it into a +2/+2 Cudgel and draw it. (Instead of: Enemy units that die transform into +2/+2 Cudgels. You draw them.)[/list]
[list]Steward of the Past - No longer has Enemy units entering the void are silenced. (Summon ability remains unchanged)[/list]

Statuary Maiden and Steward of the Past are among our more complicated cards, and have led to a variety of complex rules interactions, as well as inconsistencies in the game engine. The effects of these cards will now be easier to predict, and have a more clearly defined set of cards that they affect. In addition to alleviating issues with future design space, these changes separate the effects of the two cards, giving them more distinct play from one another.

[b]Individual Card Changes[/b]
[list]Dawnwalker - Now requires TTTT influence to return from the void.[/list]

With the change to Steward of the Past, we wanted to pull back on Dawnwalker, while also ensuring that it appears in dedicated Time decks. This change keeps Dawnwalker’s core functionality, while reducing how frequently it gets replayed in the early turns of the game.

[list]Elysian Trailblazer - Now 5PP instead of 5P.[/list]
[list]Elysian Pathfinder - Now 5TT instead of 5T.[/list]

We are adding an influence to each of these cards to increase the opportunity cost of splashing them in multi-faction decks.

[list]Withering Witch - Now only hits undamaged enemies.[/list]

Withering Witch has been one of the more confusing cards from a rules perspective, and has led to unintuitive interactions and play patterns. This change preserves the intended functionality, while cleaning up rules confusion.

[list]Black-Sky Harbinger - Now 4/5 (instead of 3/5)[/list]

Black-Sky Harbinger gives Feln a strong tool against a variety of decks, and helps promote more interactive gameplay. This change gives Feln more power in the six-drop slot, and may push more players to leaning on Black-Sky Harbinger. The change also gives Feln decks a wider range in stats, moving the Harbinger away from Feln Bloodcaster and Steward of the Past.

[list]Devastating Setback - Now 3SS and the -2/-2 is this turn (instead of 4SS and the -2/-2 is permanent)[/list]

Devastating Setback gives Shadow decks a flexible card against both aggressive decks and more controlling ones, and we want to promote that type of counter-play and interaction. This change could push more decks to using Setback as a way to interact early against aggro.

[list]Torgov, Icecap Trader - Now gets +3/+3 from 10 cards in your void (instead of 15)[/list]
[list]Alu, Death-Dreamer - Now 5-cost (instead of 6-cost)[/list]

These are both cards with fun effects and interesting deckbuilding possibilities, and these buffs should open the door to more play.

[list]Argenport Instigator - Now 2SS (instead of 2S)[/list]

We’ve been concerned about the speed and strength of Stonescar Aggro decks and wanted to reduce the ease with which Argenport Instigator can be paired with Fire one-drops, while preserving the card’s high power level. We expect that a second Shadow influence requirement will increase diversity among two-drops, while increasing the incentive to branch out into a greater variety of aggro decks.

[list]Stonepowder Alchemist - Now 3JS (instead of 4JS)[/list]

Reducing the cost of Stonepowder Alchemist gives players another powerful tool against aggressive decks, while also adding a valuable dimension to certain Gunslinger strategies.

[b]The Dusk Road Buffs[/b]
[list]Hideout Pistol - Now +2/+0 (instead of +1/+0)[/list]
[list]Callous Survivalist - Now 9SS (instead of 9SSS)[/list]
[list]Battlefield Scavenger - Now 4 to ultimate (instead of 5)[/list]
[list]Inquisitor's Halberd - Now gains +3 Armor (instead of +2 Armor)[/list]
[list]Clutchkeeper - Now 14PPP (instead of 15PPP)[/list]
[list]Yeti Furflinger - Now 3/4 (instead of 3/3)[/list]
[list]Gear Master - Now 3TT 1/1 (instead of 4TT 2/2)[/list]
[list]Talir's Intervention - Now gains 4 health (instead of 3), and can silence an enemy unit (instead of an attacking enemy unit)[/list]
[list]Scrap Hound - Now gets +5/+5 when you sacrifice a Grenadin (instead of +4/+4)[/list]
[list]Kaleb's Intervention - Now can kill a weapon or relic (instead of only weapons)[/list]

[list]To provide increased control over The Dusk Road draft experience, both Dusk Road packs passed in a draft will come from the same player (player A), and the Omens of the Past and The Empty Throne packs will come from the same other player (player B).  We have also introduced a new collation system that will be used with Dusk Road packs (and other packs going forward) to help increase diversity among commons. These changes allow for better use of the signals from the first pack of The Dusk Road, in predicting what might show up in the second pack of The Dusk Road.[/list]
[list]Players will now also have more control over the player passing to them for Omens of the Past and The Empty Throne.[/list]

[b]Card Changes Aimed at Draft[/b]
[list]Valkyrie Arcanist - Now 6JJ (instead of 5JJ)[/list]
[list]Emerald Spear - Now 7J +4/+3 (instead of 6J +3/+3)[/list]
[list]Frontier Confessor - Now 4J 3/2 (instead of 5J 3/4)[/list]

Justice-based draft decks, particularly those that tie up the ground and win in the air, were a little too dominant. These changes aim to slightly reduce how easy this is and hopefully open up diversity of draft strategies.

[b]Cleaning Up Rules Around Void Interaction[/b]
[list]Statuary Maiden - Now reads: Enemy units can't Entomb or Revenge. When an enemy unit dies, transform it into a +2/+2 Cudgel and draw it. (Instead of: Enemy units that die transform into +2/+2 Cudgels. You draw them.)[/list]
[list]Steward of the Past - No longer has Enemy units entering the void are silenced. (Summon ability remains unchanged)[/list]

Statuary Maiden and Steward of the Past are among our more complicated cards, and have led to a variety of complex rules interactions, as well as inconsistencies in the game engine. The effects of these cards will now be easier to predict, and have a more clearly defined set of cards that they affect. In addition to alleviating issues with future design space, these changes separate the effects of the two cards, giving them more distinct play from one another.

[b]Individual Card Changes[/b]
[list]Dawnwalker - Now requires TTTT influence to return from the void.[/list]

With the change to Steward of the Past, we wanted to pull back on Dawnwalker, while also ensuring that it appears in dedicated Time decks. This change keeps Dawnwalker’s core functionality, while reducing how frequently it gets replayed in the early turns of the game.

[list]Elysian Trailblazer - Now 5PP instead of 5P.[/list]
[list]Elysian Pathfinder - Now 5TT instead of 5T.[/list]

We are adding an influence to each of these cards to increase the opportunity cost of splashing them in multi-faction decks.

[list]Withering Witch - Now only hits undamaged enemies.[/list]

Withering Witch has been one of the more confusing cards from a rules perspective, and has led to unintuitive interactions and play patterns. This change preserves the intended functionality, while cleaning up rules confusion.

[list]Black-Sky Harbinger - Now 4/5 (instead of 3/5)[/list]

Black-Sky Harbinger gives Feln a strong tool against a variety of decks, and helps promote more interactive gameplay. This change gives Feln more power in the six-drop slot, and may push more players to leaning on Black-Sky Harbinger. The change also gives Feln decks a wider range in stats, moving the Harbinger away from Feln Bloodcaster and Steward of the Past.

[list]Devastating Setback - Now 3SS and the -2/-2 is this turn (instead of 4SS and the -2/-2 is permanent)[/list]

Devastating Setback gives Shadow decks a flexible card against both aggressive decks and more controlling ones, and we want to promote that type of counter-play and interaction. This change could push more decks to using Setback as a way to interact early against aggro.

[list]Torgov, Icecap Trader - Now gets +3/+3 from 10 cards in your void (instead of 15)[/list]
[list]Alu, Death-Dreamer - Now 5-cost (instead of 6-cost)[/list]

These are both cards with fun effects and interesting deckbuilding possibilities, and these buffs should open the door to more play.

[list]Argenport Instigator - Now 2SS (instead of 2S)[/list]

We’ve been concerned about the speed and strength of Stonescar Aggro decks and wanted to reduce the ease with which Argenport Instigator can be paired with Fire one-drops, while preserving the card’s high power level. We expect that a second Shadow influence requirement will increase diversity among two-drops, while increasing the incentive to branch out into a greater variety of aggro decks.

[list]Stonepowder Alchemist - Now 3JS (instead of 4JS)[/list]

Reducing the cost of Stonepowder Alchemist gives players another powerful tool against aggressive decks, while also adding a valuable dimension to certain Gunslinger strategies.

[b]The Dusk Road Buffs[/b]
[list]Hideout Pistol - Now +2/+0 (instead of +1/+0)[/list]
[list]Callous Survivalist - Now 9SS (instead of 9SSS)[/list]
[list]Battlefield Scavenger - Now 4 to ultimate (instead of 5)[/list]
[list]Inquisitor's Halberd - Now gains +3 Armor (instead of +2 Armor)[/list]
[list]Clutchkeeper - Now 14PPP (instead of 15PPP)[/list]
[list]Yeti Furflinger - Now 3/4 (instead of 3/3)[/list]
[list]Gear Master - Now 3TT 1/1 (instead of 4TT 2/2)[/list]
[list]Talir's Intervention - Now gains 4 health (instead of 3), and can silence an enemy unit (instead of an attacking enemy unit)[/list]
[list]Scrap Hound - Now gets +5/+5 when you sacrifice a Grenadin (instead of +4/+4)[/list]
[list]Kaleb's Intervention - Now can kill a weapon or relic (instead of only weapons)[/list]

notes.title: 1.28 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/ae00c670512d3ab20d9467648b70d877a69abd9e.png[/img]

[b]1.28 Patch Notes[/b]

[b]New Promo Card: Bloodscent Avisaur[/b]
[list]Over the next few weeks, you’ll be able to collect all four copies of the new card with your first versus win each day![/list]

[b]New Puzzles[/b]
[list]New advanced puzzles are now available![/list]
[list]The collection of new puzzles brings the total puzzle count to over 100! So, a new achievement has been added for completing 100 puzzles.[/list]

[b]Draft Update and Card Changes[/b]
[list]Pack passing in Draft has been updated and there are multiple card balance updates. Please check out the full list of changes in the Draft and Card Changes tile.[/list]

[b]AI Deck Updates[/b]
[list]Several of the new and updated AI decks containing cards from The Dusk Road have been modified to reduce difficulty. As always, we’ll keep an eye on their performance and make any additional changes as needed.[/list]

[b]UI Updates[/b]
[list]All cards now indicate which set they’re from when full-zoomed in the deckbuilder.[/list]
[list]Premium avatars for sale in the store can now be previewed on the playmat.[/list]
[list]Theme decks for sale in the store will now highlight the rare cards they contain in the preview.[/list]
[list]While not expected, if matching fails for any reason, you’ll now be notified and encouraged to queue again.[/list]
[list]The new queue screen should now have indicators that display if you are experiencing poor internet connection.[/list]

[b]Improved Network Stability[/b]
Matches should be more resilient to high latency networks.  If you run into issues when attempting to reconnect, please send feedback through the options menu in game.

[b]Performance[/b]
We've made multiple performance improvements across all platforms to reduce load times and smooth game play. As always, if you run into any performance issues, please send feedback through the options menu in game.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[b]General[/b]
[list]You can now change the quantity of a card in the Create All modal.[/list]
[list]Bushes below the enemy totem should no longer cover your void.[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]Replay should no longer remove the Night visuals from the playmat.[/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]When cards with dynamic costs are played by card abilities for free, they should no longer reduce the dynamic effect by 2.[/list]
[list]Spells with Overwhelm should now properly redirect to the enemy player if their original target was removed in response.[/list]
[b]Card Fixes[/b]
[list]Thudrock, Arctic Artisan now has custom VFX for the Snowman created.[/list]
[list]If Levitate’s target dies in response, you should now still draw the card.[/list]
[list]Stirring Sands should now work if played from Great-Kiln Titan’s ability.[/list]
[list]Units that cause a card to be drawn as a result of being played should now properly get the +1/+1 from Tesya, Omen Shaper if she is on top of the deck.[/list]
[list]Panoptic Guardian should now still display the top card of a deck after that top card was changed from Scout.[/list]
[list]Winter’s Grasp should no longer indefinitely stun units that were transformed at Night.[/list]
[list]Dragonbreath targeting a unit with Overwhelm should still deal damage to the enemy player if the target was removed from play in response.[/list]
[list]Valkyrie Bodyguard should no longer be able to use Killer if the player has no armor.[/list]
[list]Pummel should no longer be playable unless you have an attacking unit.[/list]

notes.title: 1.27 New Set: The Dusk Road
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/bce60636c135f75529f2373516dd32c97542425f.jpg[/img]

[b]New Set: The Dusk Road[/b]
[list]
[*] A new set hits [i]Eternal[/i] with over 275 new cards and new mechanics!
[*] The Draft format has changed to draft the new set alongside both The Empty Throne and Omens of the Past:
[*] The Dusk Road // Omens of the Past // The Empty Throne // The Dusk Road.
[*] The new set is now available for purchase from the store and can be crafted via Shiftstone.
[*] New Theme decks are now available for purchase in the store.
[/list]

[b]New Totem: The Night Lurker[/b]
[list]
[*] Reacts to the Nightfall cycles.
[*] Custom victory animation.
[*] Uncover the long-forgotten Grenadin, but don't let it get too close to the water...
[/list]
[b]Limited Time Premium Avatar[/b]
[list][*] The snowman premium avatar is available for 300 gems for a limited time.
[*] Snow falls on the profile screen and around you on the playmat.
[*] Includes a custom emote: "Thumpity, thump thump."[/list]

[b]Gauntlet/Forge Season End[/b][list]
[*] Progress for all players has been reset in both Gauntlet and Forge.
[*] New AI opponents have been added, including new bosses in the Gauntlet.
[*] Some existing AI decks have been updated to include cards from the new set.
[*] Additionally, Forge will now always grant faction experience in the two drafted factions, regardless of how many cards were drafted from each faction.[/list]

[b]Reward Update[/b][list]
[*] Packs from season rewards, rank up chests in the Gauntlet and Forge, and the free pack awarded for first win of the day have all been updated to give packs from The Dusk Road.
[*] Packs from standard chests have been updated to randomize between The Eternal Throne and Omens of the Past, weighted according to the number of cards in each set.[/list]

[b]Reckless Update[/b][list]
[*] Reckless is now considered a Battle Skill[/list]

[b]UI Updates[/b][list]
[*] All queue and loading screens have been updated with a new visual treatment. Additionally, loading games has been reworked to now pre-load while you’re in queue.
[*] Gauntlet, Forge and Draft have been updated with new animated key art.
[*] Purchasing packs in the store has been redesigned to remove confusion around which set you’re purchasing.
[*] The Message of the Day has been redesigned to give us the ability to provide more up-to-date information beyond just the patch notes.
[*] Premium relics now have a generic premium effect that plays on the relic holder.
[*] Premium card hangers now have a premium frame.[/list]

[b]Mobile Performance[/b][list]
[*] We’ve made multiple improvements to mobile performance in 1.27, specifically with regards to Android load times. As always, please send us feedback concerning any performance changes you experience.[/list]

[b]Single Sign-On[/b][list]
[*] New players will no longer be required to register as part of the tutorial.
[*] If you're a new player and want to play across multiple devices, you'll need to create an Eternal account through the in-game options. (doing so will also earn you three free packs!)
[*] Existing players will not be affected by Single Sign-On. You already have an Eternal account that you created in the tutorial.[/list]

[b]Reconnecting to Games[/b][list]
[*] Reconnecting to in-progress games has an improved flow, streamlining the time it takes to get back into your game.[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[b]Client Fixes[/b]
  [b]General[/b][list]
[*] Unowned copies of cards in Create All should now properly highlight red as unowned.
[*] Disconnecting while downloading data when you first open the game should no longer cause subsequent logins to be in broken states.[/list]
  [b]UI[/b][list]
[*] Using a mouse with a touchscreen device should no longer cause tooltips to remain on-screen indefinitely.
[*] Card hangers in extended deck view should no longer block input for being able to add/remove cards.
[*] Locking Windows or putting your PC to sleep would sometimes cause the client to switch to max resolution. This should no longer occur.[/list]
  [b]Gameplay[/b][list]
[*] Copied units should no longer permanently retain temporary buffs.
[*] Stolen spells should now correctly lose damage modifications from cards like Cloudsnake Harrier or Boltcrafter Shaman.[/list]
[b]Card Fixes[/b][list]
[*] Voprex, the Great Ruin should now have text on the choice cards he presents.
[*] Watchwing Conscript should no longer play his summon VO if he has Echo when drawn.
[*] Auric Interrogator should now always draw you a card prior to the discard effect from Azindel’s Gift, regardless of how many cards you had in hand.
[*] Lavablood Goliath should now correctly deal it’s Overwhelm damage to the opponent if the unit hit by its summon ability dies in response to the ability.
[*] Dawnwalker returning to play should no longer suppress the summon ability from Direwood Prowler.
[*] Dawnwalker returning to play should no longer suppress the Mentor ability from Nostrix, Lord of Visions.
[*] Torgov, Icecap Trader should no longer retain bonuses he received if he is stolen.
[*] Bad News should no longer leave a permanent VFX on the avatar if it was negated.
[*] Fevered Scout is now an Explorer Soldier.
[*] Sand Viper is now a Serpent.
[*] Slimespitter Slug is now a Vermin.
[/list]

notes.content:

[h1]1.26.3 Reward Update[/h1]

Based on community feedback and data collected, we've made the following tweaks to Gauntlet and Ranked rewards:

[list][*]2 wins: 2 wood chests[/*][/list]
[list][*]3 wins: 1 bronze, 2 wood chests[/*][/list]
[list][*]4 wins: 2 bronze, 1 wood chests[/*][/list][/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[b]Card Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Vara, Fate-Touched should no longer crash games when returning a unit with Revenge.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Midnight Gale should no longer lose Lifesteal due to zone transitions.[/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.26.2 Hotfix Notes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/3e071f1d3623a914f50336a4ec8599939457eaac.jpg[/img]﻿
[h1]1.26.2 Hotfix[/h1]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][b]General[/b]
[list][*]Improved data caching at startup. This change will reduce initial login times significantly, after the first login.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Opponents using premium avatars should now display the number of relics they have in play again.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The playmat VFX for Icaria’s premium avatar should no longer display over unit VFX.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The playmat VFX for Eilyn’s premium avatar should no longer block unit hinting.[/*][/list]
[list][*]You should be able to use controllers to make all in-game card selections again.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Disabling totem interactions should no longer mute your own totem.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Expanded match history was showing a count for individual turns. It should now count your turns.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Link graphics should no longer appear under unit tokens.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The blocking icon that displays on units during blocking should now be visible again.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Having the void open during Revenge should no longer display a pink avatar image.[/*][/list]
[b]Phone[/b]
[list][*]Multiple Android UI bug fixes.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Navigating between scenes, especially the playmat, should be faster on Android.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Fixed several issues around updating new files after installing. This should prevent cases where you could become stuck during these updates.[/*][/list]
[list][*]All cards should display their image in the deckbuilder deck list again.[/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.26 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/3e071f1d3623a914f50336a4ec8599939457eaac.jpg[/img]
[h1]1.26 Patch Notes[/h1]
[h1]Pale Rider Avatars: Available for a Limited Time[/h1]
[list][*]Collect all four Pale Rider premium avatars from the store for 300 gems each![/*][/list]
[list][*]These avatars will only be available for a limited time.[/*][/list]
[h1]Progression System Update[/h1]
[list][*]Level 59 for each faction has been updated to include the second upgrade of that faction’s basic totem.[/*]
[list][*]If you are already level 59+, you will be granted your totem upgrade on login.[/*][/list]
[list][*]You still have to own the totem before you can use the upgrade.[/*][/list][/list]
[h1]Expanded Match History[/h1]
[list][*]Match History can now be expanded to see additional information about your previous games.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Additional information includes:[/*]
[list][*]Factions of your opponent’s deck (based on the influence you saw them play)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Who went first[/*][/list]
[list][*]The deck you played[/*][/list]
[list][*]Who won[/*][/list]
[list][*]The turn on which the game ended[/*][/list][/list]
[list][*]You can also view the complete order of all cards in your deck for a given game.[/*][/list]
[h1]Puzzles[/h1]
[list][*]Access to Puzzles has been gated behind the completion of various stories of the Scion’s campaigns.[/*][/list]
[h1]UI[/h1]
[list][*]Deck searching has been added to the deck list display.[/*][/list]
[list][*]If you own premium copies of cards that are in your deck, there is now a one-button option to swap them in.[/*][/list]
[list][*]You can now click-through/skip campaign dialogue on the playmat.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Puzzles now offer the ability to retry them from the options menu and from the defeat screen.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The message of the day has been changed to only display once per day.[/*][/list]
[h1]Reward Updates[/h1]
[list][*]Casual: Rewards increased to a series of bronze - bronze - bronze / bronze.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Ranked: Rewards after the last silver chest for a day have been increased to mimic Casual’s rewards: bronze - bronze - bronze / bronze.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Gauntlet: Rewards reduced for 2-6 wins. 7 wins still awards 3 silver chests.[/*][/list]
[list][*]You can now only make quest progress on the first win of each game in campaigns.[/*][/list]
[h1]Matchmaking Updates[/h1]
[list][*]Deceleration, a system which would award you with fewer points on a win and take more points when you lost based on where the system thought you should be, has been removed.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Ranked: The matching system in Ranked should now favor matches within or closer to your rank.[/*][/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[b]Client Fixes[/b]
[list][b]General[/b]
[list][*]You should now be able to mute premium avatars during redraw.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Muting the enemy player should now mute the Obelisk totem’s ambient animations.[/*][/list]
[b]Phone[/b]
[list][*]You should be able to interact with the options menu again when a selection array is up.[/*][/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Cards with Destiny should now correctly be discarded to maximum hand size.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Shimmerpack copies should now correctly get double damage during the Sudden Death boss fight.[/*][/list]
[list][*]If a unit is temporarily granted a battle skill that was previously silenced twice, they wouldn’t receive the benefit of that battle skill. This should no longer occur and the unit should correctly get the battle skill a third time.[/*][/list]
[/list]
[b]Card Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Premium Journeyman Armorer should now create a premium Spiked Helm.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Copies of Triumphant Stranger should now correctly receive +1/+1 for each Stranger instead of +2/+2.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Unexpected Results should now properly be blocked by player aegis.[/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.25 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/baf4b6cdc2587f00ac5b48a16ba27bac0b3193ef.jpg[/img]
[h1]1.25 Patch Notes[/h1]
[h1]New Campaign: The Tale of Horus Traver[/h1]
[list][*]A new campaign is now available![/*][/list]
[list][*]Unlock 23 new cards as you experience the tale of Horus Traver.[/*][/list]
[list][*]25,000 Gold or 1,000 Gems.[/*][/list]
[h1]New Totems[/h1]
[list][*]Two new totems have been added to the store: the Xenan Obelisk and Stonescar Saloon![/*][/list]
[list][*]Get the Xenan Obelisk for 900 Gems.[/*]
[list][*]Custom animation when you have 8+ Power.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Uncover the hidden Clockroaches in the sand.[/*][/list][/list]
[list][*]Get the Stonescar Saloon for 1,200 Gems.[/*]
[list][*]Custom vulture that reacts to the enemy’s health.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Custom victory celebration.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Has multiple destructible pieces.[/*][/list][/list]
[h1]Progression System Updates[/h1]
[list][*]Level 20 for each faction has been updated to include the first upgrade of that faction’s basic totem.[/*]
[list][*]If you are already level 20+, you will be granted your totem upgrade on login.[/*][/list]
[list][*]You still have to own the totem before you can use the upgrade.[/*][/list][/list]
[list][*]The progression bars that represent experience points gained have been redesigned to better showcase the amount of points gained after a game.[/*][/list]
[h1]Card Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Valkyrie Militant - Now gains 2 armor (up from 1) when you play a weapon.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Cabal Bludgeoner - Now a 3/3, up from 2/3.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Sandglass Sentinel - Now a 4/6 (up from 3/6) that gets +4 strength (up from +3) when you play a spell.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Topaz Drake - Now a 5/3, up from 4/3.[/*][/list]
[h1]UI[/h1]
[list][*]Advanced Filters now has a cleaner layout to accommodate an ever-growing list of sets.[/*][/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[b]Client Fixes[/b]
[list][b]General[/b]
[list][*]The premium version of Bad News should now work for the ‘Which Do You Want First’ hidden achievement.[/*][/list]
[b]Phone[/b]
[list][*]Rarely, it was possible to get a corrupted wing in Jekk’s Bounty on mobile devices, resulting in a crash. This should no longer happen.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The keyboard should no longer present when leaving a card zoom in the deckbuilder.[/*][/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list][*]Quests should no longer disappear briefly when they first display.[/*][/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]The ‘A Shard Bargain’ boss power in the Gauntlet should no longer be blocked by aegis.[/*][/list][/list]
[b]Card Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Minotaur Lighthoof’s summon ability should now be optional.[/*][/list]
[list][*]False Prince and Hooru Envoy should no longer treat some global cards as cards that directly targeted them.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Grenadin Cannoneer’s spark ability should now be blocked by aegis.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Champion of Impulse should no longer lose her Fire threshold ability after changing zones.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Cards transformed by Knucklebones should no longer preserve their cost reduction.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Coming Soon! The Tale of Horus Traver
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/b8966285861649a469005a34dd72852fd2498506.jpg[/img]

Join us for a dark, new chapter in the unfolding story of [i]Eternal Card Game[/i].

Coming soon, you’ll be able to experience [i]The Tale of Horus Traver[/i] in [i]Eternal[/i]’s second campaign, introducing 23 brand new cards, and 16 single-player games with fun boss powers to challenge you along your journey.

Sickness has fallen across the land of Myria, ravaging its people.  When a simple homesteader goes in search of medicine for his family, he sets in motion events that will change his life – and the world – forever.

[i]The Tale of Horus Traver[/i] will be available soon for 25,000 Gold or 1,000 Gems — win some chests and stock up!

Delve deeper into the world of [i]Eternal [/i]when [i]The Tale of Horus Traver[/i] begins!

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/f6fe4ef54a0a31e0aa2cbe546bcb90e6f98a2d57.png[/img]
﻿[h1]1.24 Patch Notes[/h1]
[h1]Faction Progress[/h1]
[list][*]You can now earn experience in each of the five factions.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Unlock a variety of rewards as you level up, including custom emotes, deck images and a premium avatar of each of the five Scions! (Faction totem upgrades coming soon!)[/*][/list]
[h1]UI[/h1]
[list][*]The Profile scene has been streamlined to remove load and ease transitions between its sub menus.[/*][/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[b]Client Fixes[/b]
[list][b]General[/b]
[list][*]The email field in registration should no longer be case sensitive.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The Eternal Throne totem should now respect the mute option.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The Deadly Diamond puzzle has been modified to remove an unintended solution.[/*][/list]
[b]Phone[/b]
[list][*]Your Masters rank should now display properly in Ranked deck select.[/*]
[b]UI[/b]
[list][*]Idling during the special rules pop-up at the start of a game should no longer gate animations until it is dismissed.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Power cards should now properly display the red border in the deck list if you don’t own all copies in the deck.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Opponents using a premium avatar should no longer have their health clip through the frame.[/*][/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]The Knowledge Storm boss power should no longer remove Aegis.[/*][/list][/list]
[/list]

﻿[h1]1.24 Patch Notes[/h1]
[h1]Faction Progress[/h1]
[list][*]You can now earn experience in each of the five factions.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Unlock a variety of rewards as you level up, including custom emotes, deck images and a premium avatar of each of the five Scions! (Faction totem upgrades coming soon!)[/*][/list]
[h1]UI[/h1]
[list][*]The Profile scene has been streamlined to remove load and ease transitions between its sub menus.[/*][/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[b]Client Fixes[/b]
[list][b]General[/b]
[list][*]The email field in registration should no longer be case sensitive.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The Eternal Throne totem should now respect the mute option.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The Deadly Diamond puzzle has been modified to remove an unintended solution.[/*][/list]
[b]Phone[/b]
[list][*]Your Masters rank should now display properly in Ranked deck select.[/*]
[b]UI[/b]
[list][*]Idling during the special rules pop-up at the start of a game should no longer gate animations until it is dismissed.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Power cards should now properly display the red border in the deck list if you don’t own all copies in the deck.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Opponents using a premium avatar should no longer have their health clip through the frame.[/*][/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]The Knowledge Storm boss power should no longer remove Aegis.[/*][/list][/list]
[/list]

notes.title: 1.23 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/72e21476999d5ddccbbfd1f31a0479c52f5ed799.png[/img]

[h1]1.23 Patch Notes[/h1]
[h1]Invite Your Friends[/h1]
[list][*]You can now invite your friends to join you in [i]Eternal[/i]![/*][/list]
[list][*]Here are the benefits to inviting your friends:[/*]
[list][*]Earn rewards for the first 10 friends that you get to join and complete all of the Scion campaigns, including Wump and Nictotraxian avatars that can’t be earned anywhere else![/*][/list]
[list][*]Your friends will receive a unique Valkyrie theme deck with a premium Valkyrie Spireguard![/*][/list]
[list][*]You’ll earn a unique Yeti theme deck with a premium Wump, Party Starter card![/*][/list][/list]
[h1]Founder Packages[/h1]
Thank you for being a part of [i]Eternal[/i] and helping us grow!
[list][*]As a special thank you, Founder Packages have been added to the store for a limited time only.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Everyone can purchase the Molot & Nakova premium avatar from the store for 300 Gems![/*][/list]
[list][*]There are three additional Founder Packages. Choose the Founder Package that suits you![/*]
[list][*][b]The Eternal Throne Package:[/b][/*]
[list][*]1,000 Gems[/*][/list]
[list][*]The Eternal Throne totem[/*][/list][/list]
[list][*][b]The Bounty Hunter Package:[/b][/*]
[list][*]2,000 Gems[/*][/list]
[list][*]The Eternal Throne totem[/*][/list]
[list][*]Complete set of Premium Sigils (unlimited quantity, just like the basic sigils)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Premium Jekk avatar with custom bullet-hole VFX on the playmat[/*][/list][/list]
[list][*][b]The Liberator Package:[/b][/*]
[list][*]6,000 Gems[/*][/list]
[list][*]The Eternal Throne totem[/*][/list]
[list][*]Complete set of Premium Sigils[/*][/list]
[list][*]Premium Jekk, the Bounty Hunter avatar[/*][/list]
[list][*]Premium Icaria avatar with custom valkyrie wing VFX on the playmat[/*][/list][/list][/list]
[list][*]While most of the content from the Founder Packages will be removed from the store after the limited time availability, the Eternal Throne totem will remain available in the totem page of the store for 900 gems.[/*][/list]
[h1]Puzzles[/h1]
[list][*]Puzzles are now available![/*][/list]
[list][*]There are 80 new Puzzles that range in difficulty from learning how battle skills interact to more challenging brain-teasers.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Each puzzle offers a gold reward for completing it.[/*][/list]
[h1]Card Updates[/h1]
[i]The following cards have changed. Shiftstone refunds will be available for a limited time for all copies you had previously crafted.[/i]
[b]These changes fall under three specific areas:[/b]
[list][*]Buffs to enable more Time, Justice, Primal, and Shadow strategies:[/*]
[list][*]Aid of the Hooru (now draw four instead of draw two)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Avirax Familiar (now 1/2 instead of 1/1)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Banish (now 3-cost instead of 4-cost)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Bloodcall Invocation (now 1-cost instead of 2-cost)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Bloodletter (now +3/+3 instead of +3/+2)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Cat Burglar (now 3/2 instead of 2/2)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Crownwatch Squire (now 1/2 instead of 1/1)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Evelina, Valley Searcher (now 2-cost instead of 3-cost)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Fencing Master (now 3J instead of 3JJ)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Mask of Torment (now 20-cost ultimate instead of 25-cost)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Minotaur Lighthoof (now 4-cost 4/4 instead of 5-cost 4/5)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Watcher of the Big Ones (now 4-cost 3/6 instead of 5-cost 4/6)[/*][/list][/list]
[list][*]Nerfs to pull back on Armory, while also increasing diversity among Armory strategies:[/*]
[list][*]Smuggler's Stash (now costs 6FS instead of 5FS)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Inspire (now costs 2J instead of 1J)[/*][/list][/list]
[list][*]All three of the Powersurge cards have been reworked and the Powersurge skill has been removed:[/*]
[list][*]Charchain Flail - Now 2FF +1/+1, Summon: Spend your remaining power to give Charchain Flail that much strength.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Copper Conduit - Now 2T 1/1, Overwhelm Summon: Spend your remaining power to give Copper Conduit that much strength and health.[/*]
[list][*]Additionally, there was custom enter-play logic that allowed it and some other cards to interact with cards that cared about stats as they entered-play. In order to line up the rules around Summon abilities, this interaction has been removed.[/*][/list][/list]
[list][*]Flame Blast - Now 2FFF, Deal 1 damage. Spend your remaining power to increase the damage dealt by that much.[/*][/list][/list]
[h1]UI[/h1]
[list][*]All of the basic totems have had “miss” VFX added for clicks that don’t activate the flag animation.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Additional phone-specific interface updates.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The crafting animation for creating and destroying cards has been updated.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Premium cards now have a subtle animation to the card frame.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Premium cards have an additional highlight during pack opening.[/*][/list]
[list][*]All non-basic power cards have received an updated frame.[/*][/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[b]Client Fixes[/b]
[list][b]General[/b]
[list][*]Empty spaces at the end of a line should no longer invalidate a decklist for import.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The Skill Up achievement should no longer count each instance of Warcry as a separate skill.[/*][/list]
[b]Phone[/b]
[list][*]Trying to emote while your hand is zoomed should now correctly emote instead of unzooming your hand.[/*][/list]
[list][*]X in deckbuilder search should now correctly clear text in the field.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Progress text accompanying the chest opening after winning a Casual game should no longer say "Ranked".[/*][/list]
[list][*]You should now be able to tap-and-hold to look at units on the playmat when observing a friend.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Android devices should now have a quit button in options.[/*][/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list][*]You should now be able to see the highlight for which cards your opponent is looking at in their hand again.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The wooden chests opened from winning a Casual game should now show the correct amount of gold earned.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Observing a friend during redraw should no longer remove their avatar and power from the playmat.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Achievements and quest progress should now wait until the Victory/Defeat screen before appearing.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The options to test initial draw and redraw should no longer disappear when leaving and returning to the sample hand feature.[/*][/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Playing a spell with Destiny that would prevent a unit from dying in response to a damage spell should no longer make the unit disappear from the game.[/*][/list][/list]
[b]Card Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Copies of Rilgon, Hooru Operative should now correctly lose Double Damage according to the card’s rules.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Means to an End should no longer be able to fire multiple instances of 25 damage if you gain multiple instances of health and have no cards left in your deck.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Means to an End should now count its damage dealt toward the Shadow Warrior quest.[/*][/list]
[list][*]If Cloud of Ash is negated, it should no longer leave fire VFX on the opponent for the rest of the game.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Slimespitter Slug should no longer continue to gain health while in your hand when an enemy unit dies after being returned to your hand.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Fencing Master’s ultimate should no longer activate when a stun spell hits an enemy unit with endurance since that unit is immune to stun.[/*][/list]
[list][*]There should no longer be a long delay between Jarall’s Frostkin’s projectile and its impact animation.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Enemy players that discard cards due to Azindel’s Gift should now correctly show a single copy of each card discarded.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Units that have been stolen, damaged, and then returned to their owner should now heal the correct amount at the end of the turn if their owner has a Xenan Obelisk in play.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Sindok, Rage Incarnate should retain its cost reduction after being returned to hand.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Units with Lifeforce abilities which resolve at the end of your turn should no longer get the VFX hint if you gain life during your opponent’s turn.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Health should no longer be gained when an enemy unit dies when you have both Slimespitter Slug and Statuary Maiden in play.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Lumbering Gruan should no longer stun itself in response to getting attacked by a relic weapon.[/*][/list]
[list][*]You should no longer be able to select the same card for multiple Memory Dredgers hitting the enemy player.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Cards transformed into monuments due to Knucklebones should now properly transmute when drawn.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The copy created from an Echo spell that had its damage modified by Maelstrom Bell should now properly retain the increased damage.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Strength of Many should no longer be able to be played on enemy units.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Armorsmith should now correctly reset its cost if it is stolen by a player that doesn’t have any armor.[/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.22 Patch Notes: Omens of the Past
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/1768ac0774103bf0879dea5407cd3599effe828e.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Set: Omens of the Past[/h1]
[list][*]A new set hits [i]Eternal[/i] with over 250 new cards and new mechanics![/*][/list]
[list][*]Draft format has changed to alternate between Omens of the Past and The Empty Throne packs.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The new set is now available for purchase from the store and can be crafted via Shiftstone.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Theme decks for Omens of the Past are now available for purchase in the store.[/*][url=http://www.direwolfdigital.com/eternal/omens-of-the-past-theme-decks/]Theme Decks[/url][/list]
[list][*]Forge Wolf, Cloudsnake Hatchling and the five Banners have been moved to Omens of the Past to support the Draft mode.[/*][/list]
[h1]Gauntlet/Forge Season End[/h1]
[list][*]Progress for all players has been reset in both Gauntlet and Forge with the addition of Omens of the Past.[/*][/list]

[list][*]Some existing AI decks have been updated to include cards from Omens of the Past.[/*][/list]
[h1]Phone Support[/h1]
[list][*]Phones now have custom UI and features to make Eternal more user-friendly on mobile devices. This includes:[/*]
[list][*]Larger card tiles in deckbuilder.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Deck list can be collapsed while drafting.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Customized playmat layout with a hand that can expand/collapse.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Streamlined interactions with many elements of the UI to work better on phones.[/*][/list][/list]
[h1]Casual Mode[/h1]
[list][*]Casual queue is now available![/*][/list]
[h1]Premium Cards[/h1]
[list][*]Premium cards now have a unique premium frame treatment.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Premium and non-premium cards now stack in deck lists.[/*][/list]

[list][*]Navani, Warsinger now has unique VFX indicating that her Warcry hits the entire deck.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Many cards from The Empty Throne have been updated to adhere to new wording templates.[/*][/list]
[h1]Rewards Update[/h1]
[list][*]A ‘First Win of the Day’ reward has been added to grant a free pack from Omens of the Past for your first Ranked or Casual win each day.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The reward cycle in Ranked has been updated.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Cards from Bronze, Silver and Diamond chests can now include cards from Omens of the Past.[/*][/list]
[h1]UI[/h1]
[list][*]The client has been updated with a new font.[/*][/list]
[list][*]General UI updates throughout the client.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Chat has been streamlined with several quality of life improvements.[/*][/list]
[list][*]A glossary of all skills, battle skills, and card types has been added to the options menu.[/*][/list]
[h1]Matchmaking[/h1]
[list][*]The Masters rank has been updated to better incentivize skill compared to raw number of games played.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Some high MMR players were experiencing difficulty climbing in subsequent seasons due to the difference in their MMR and the MMR of their opponents. To alleviate this, the penalty for playing against a lower MMR player has been removed.[/*][/list]
[h1]Turn Timer Updates[/h1]
[list][*]Turn timers have been updated to reduce the negative impact of players who intentionally abuse their turn timers.[/*][/list]
[h1]Theme Deck Quests[/h1]
[list][*]The delay between Theme Deck Quests has been reduced to 3 days from 7.[/*][/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[b]Client Fixes[/b]
[list][b]General[/b]
[list][*]Controllers should now be able to zoom cards in the rare slot during pack opening.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Idling out during a Gauntlet or Forge game should now correctly count the game as a loss.[/*][/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list][*]You should now be able to receive tool-tips for playmat elements after a game ends, before the victory/defeat screen.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Rarely, the End Turn button would disable and not be clickable. That should no longer happen.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Weapon hangers should now use the correct hanger layout for weapons.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Mousing-over your avatar before the resolution of a unit played from Destiny that has a summon ability should no longer cause a blank card hanger to display.[/*][/list]
[list][*]It should no longer be possible to cause a mouse-over zoom on a unit to rapidly switch sides during the zoom.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The last played opponent in the social menu should now include opponents from Events.[/*][/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Drawing a card with Destiny when it can’t be played (ex: Scourge of Frosthome is in play) should now discard the Destiny card and draw a new card.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Drawing a card with Destiny that has no legal play should now discard the Destiny card and draw a new card.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Units that have lifesteal and an Entomb ability that deals damage should now grant you health equal to the damage dealt.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Lifesteal should now correctly resolve if the source was killed in response (example: killing a Black Sky Harbinger in response to its damage should no longer prevent the health gain).[/*][/list][/list] 
[b]Card Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Dawnwalker should no longer play his summon VFX over the enemy totem as he returns from the void.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Borderlands Waykeeper should now correctly play a VFX when using her ultimate ability.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Icebreaker should now correctly shoot its VFX to the unit it is targeting rather than itself.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Shadowlands Feaster should now correctly steal all units to your void when multiple die simultaneously.[/*][/list]
[list][*]A Nictotraxian with Echo that creates a card with Echo should now correctly Echo that created card.[/*][/list]
[list][*]A Nictotraxian with Echo should now correctly present itself to the opponent.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Crown of Possibilities should now correctly grant a skill to a unit created by a Nictotraxian with Echo.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Diplomatic Seal should no longer clip through other cards in hand when being played.[/*][/list][url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/1768ac0774103bf0879dea5407cd3599effe828e.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/f42c8ea81af8b90c7420557fc58d930c2e8ce8ad.jpg[/img][/url]
